title: The open/closed comparison commutes with closure extension identifications
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite discrete commutative ring. Use ordinary derived categories of constant-$A$ module sheaves on the small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Write $C_W=\nu_W^*$ for the exact etale/pro-etale comparison [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism, def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback]. For an open immersion $j$ [def-weil-open-immersion], let $o_j:C_Xj_{e,!}\xrightarrow{\sim}j_{p,!}C_U$ be the termwise canonical open comparison [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison], using extensions by zero [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero, def-weil-extension-by-zero], and let $a_j:C_Uj_e^*\xrightarrow{\sim}j_p^*C_X$ be the canonical pullback comparison [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback]. For a closed immersion $h:Z\hookrightarrow X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion], let $\delta_h:C_XRh_{e,*}\xrightarrow{\sim}Rh_{p,*}C_Z$ on $D^+$ be the specified counit-mate comparison [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate], and let $a_h:C_Zh_e^*\xrightarrow{\sim}h_p^*C_X$ be canonical pullback comparison. Subscripts $e,p$ mean etale and pro-etale. Composition is read right to left.

Let $T$ be Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth, def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme], let $s:S\hookrightarrow T$ be an immersion with factorization $s=v\circ c$ (closed then open), and let $(u:S\hookrightarrow\bar S,i:\bar S\hookrightarrow T)$ be its scheme-theoretic closure factorization (open then closed) [def-nagata-scheme-theoretic-image]. Here $\bar S=\operatorname{SIm}(s)$ is the closed subscheme cut out by the largest quasi-coherent ideal contained in $\ker(\mathcal O_T\to s_*\mathcal O_S)$; $i$ is its image inclusion and $u$ its canonical factor map. These immersions into the Noetherian scheme $T$ are quasi-compact, so this ideal is the kernel itself. On either site put $F_\tau=v_{\tau,!}c_{\tau,*}$ and $E_\tau=i_{\tau,*}u_{\tau,!}$. Let $q_\tau:F_\tau\xrightarrow{\sim}E_\tau$ be the termwise normalized identification restricting to the identity on $S$ [lem-sfb-etale-locally-closed-extension-comparison, lem-sfb-locally-closed-extension-coherence]. For every $L\in D^+(S_e,A)$ define
$$\Delta_L=v_{p,!}(\delta_{c,L})o_{v,c_{e,*}L},\qquad B_L=i_{p,*}(o_{u,L})\delta_{i,u_{e,!}L}.$$
These are natural isomorphisms, and their specified maps satisfy
$$q_{p,C_SL}\Delta_L=B_LC_T(q_{e,L}).$$
The closed and open restriction identifications used here agree through the canonical pullback compositor for $s$. In particular, for a second factorization $s=v'\circ c'$, put $t_\tau=(q'_\tau)^{-1}q_\tau:F_\tau\xrightarrow{\sim}F'_\tau$. Then
$$t_{p,C_SL}\Delta_L=\Delta'_LC_T(t_{e,L}).$$
The $t_\tau$ are the identity-normalized change-of-factorization maps and obey identity and cocycle laws.
